hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.py) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && uv run ruff check --fix -q "$f"; uv run ruff format -q "$f";; esac; exit 0

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; hits=$(grep -rnE --include='*.py' '^(from|import) mlx(_vlm|_lm)?\b' nmv/ app_pages/ streamlit_app.py) || exit 0; printf 'Module-scope MLX import detected. CLAUDE.md invariant: mlx-vlm and mlx-lm are imported only inside worker functions, never at module scope (MLX evaluates an array only on the thread that queued it, so all MLX work, imports included, stays on the nmv.runtime worker; Streamlit reruns on a fresh thread). Move the import into the function body.\n%s\n' "$hits" >&2; exit 2
